preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The length of the array a is between 2 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each element of the array a is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all arrays a across all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: For each test case, print the sum of the final array.
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the maximum sum of all elements of the final array that can be obtained by performing the given operations.
